content: Within three months, Sabrina will complete a 3-step obstacle course involving crawling, climbing, and jumping with minimal assistance in 4 out of 5 opportunities, improving gross motor coordination and endurance.
Within four months, Sabrina will thread a shoelace through a series of holes on a lacing card independently in 4 out of 5 opportunities to enhance fine motor dexterity and bilateral coordination.

Within five months, Sabrina will independently dress herself with appropriate clothing (e.g., putting on a t-shirt) with verbal cues in 4 out of 5 opportunities, improving self-care and adaptive skills.
Within three months, Sabrina will hold a spoon and use it to scoop and eat yogurt with minimal spillage in 4 out of 5 opportunities during meal times, enhancing self-feeding skills.
Within four months, Sabrina will participate in a sensory bin activity independently for 5 minutes with no more than 1 verbal cue, demonstrating improved sensory processing and engagement in play.
Within six months, Sabrina will engage in a turn-taking game with a peer or therapist for at least 5 minutes with minimal prompts, fostering social participation and cooperative play.
Within three months, Sabrina will draw a vertical line on paper using a crayon with a mature grasp in 4 out of 5 opportunities with moderate prompts, advancing pre-writing skills.
